intuition: A pointer represents the untouched infinite suffix, while a min-heap stores smaller numbers that were added back.

brute_force.approach: Maintain an explicit set of all currently available positive integers and scan for its minimum.

optimal.approach: Return the next pointer value unless a min-heap contains a smaller restored number; use a set to avoid duplicate heap entries.
optimal.time: popSmallest O(log n), addBack O(log n)

edge_cases: Adding back a number already available makes no change.
Numbers at or beyond the pointer cannot have been removed from the infinite suffix.
